going-well-and-scared.name: It's Going Well And I'm Waiting For It To Go Wrong
going-well-and-scared.question: Everything's finally going well, so why am I this frightened?
going-well-and-scared.shape: The good is real and the fear is older than the man, so the order runs: what is good, when the dread arrives, where the watching was learned, what it pays, what it costs, and what she would have to say.

positions.name: What's actually good here
positions.job: What is genuinely good here, and what of it is solid. The part that is real, not a run-up to bad news

positions.name: The moment the dread arrives
positions.job: The ordinary moment the fear arrives — a quiet phone, a good evening ending. Not a mood she is in all day

positions.name: Where the watching was learned
positions.job: The last time something was good and then was not, and what she decided that day about good things

positions.name: What being braced pays you
positions.job: What being braced still earns her. Being first to know, and never being caught out at the end again

positions.name: What the watching takes from your days
positions.job: What the watching takes out of her own days. Every good evening spent half somewhere else, waiting for the turn

positions.name: What would have to be said out loud
positions.job: What she would have to say out loud, and to whom, for the watching to stop. No proof from him will do it

the-money-somebody-else-is-holding.name: The Money Somebody Else Is Holding
the-money-somebody-else-is-holding.question: Somebody else is holding what was meant to come to me. Where do I actually stand?
the-money-somebody-else-is-holding.shape: What is held, why it is held, what the holder gets from it, whether it is still moving, what the waiting costs and what it pays — and then the one piece that needs nobody else's signature.

positions.name: What's actually being held
positions.job: What is genuinely in play here, and what has only ever been assumed to be there. Not anyone's account of it

positions.name: What the money is standing in for
positions.job: The older thing between them that the money is now carrying. What was unsettled long before there was anything to divide

positions.name: What the holder gets from holding it
positions.job: What the person holding it gets from holding it. The thing they would lose the day it was handed over

positions.name: Stalled, or stopped
positions.job: Whether the person holding it is still moving on this or has quietly stopped, and what their behaviour shows. Not a month

positions.name: What every month of waiting takes
positions.job: What every month of waiting takes out of her life. The decision she has not made because this is unfinished

positions.name: What's still yours while it's unsettled
positions.job: What is still hers while this is unsettled. Being owed keeps something open that a final no would close

positions.name: The part that needs nobody's signature
positions.job: The one piece of this she can settle without them, and what settling it costs her

is-he-the-one.name: Is He The One
is-he-the-one.question: Is he the one, and how would I even know?
is-he-the-one.shape: The question is a test she has never written down, so the order is the test, whose it is, what it pays, what it costs, and what would actually settle it.

positions.name: Where the two of you actually stand
positions.job: Where the two of them actually stand today. What has been settled between them in fact, and what has only been felt

positions.name: The test he's being put through
positions.job: The test she is quietly running on him. What would have to happen before she called it settled

positions.name: Whose test it is
positions.job: Where that test came from. Whose marriage, or which earlier man, wrote the standard she is measuring him against

positions.name: What the open question buys you
positions.job: What the question itself pays her. While it stays open, nobody has to be chosen and nothing has to be risked

positions.name: What the testing costs him
positions.job: What the testing takes out of what they already have. What it does to a man who is being measured and not told

positions.name: What would actually settle it
positions.job: What would actually settle this, and it is not a sign about him. The thing she would have to decide

my-child-doesnt-call.name: My Child Doesn't Call
my-child-doesnt-call.question: My child stopped speaking to me. What's actually going on, and what's left for me to do?
my-child-doesnt-call.shape: A silence has a story on the far side of it, somebody holding that story steady, and a bill running on this side — all three come before the one move that needs no reply.

positions.name: What the silence is made of
positions.job: What the silence is actually made of, as the cut shows it. The shape of the distance, before anybody's reason for it

positions.name: The version of the family on the other side
positions.job: The version of the family her grown child is living inside. What happened, in that account, not in hers

positions.name: Who else is standing in the gap
positions.job: Who else is standing in the gap. A partner, a sibling, the other parent — and what the distance does for them

positions.name: How the messages land at the other end
positions.job: How the messages she does send land at the other end. What they read as there, which is not what she meant

positions.name: What the waiting has taken
positions.job: What the waiting has taken out of the rest of her life. The things she stopped doing while the phone stayed quiet

positions.name: What the open door keeps
positions.job: What holding the door open still keeps intact. The thing she has not yet had to accept, for as long as it stays open

positions.name: The one thing that needs no reply
positions.job: The one thing here that is hers to do and needs no reply to work. What doing it costs her

should-i-quit-my-job.name: Should I Quit My Job
should-i-quit-my-job.question: Should I quit this job, or is it me that needs to change?
should-i-quit-my-job.shape: What changed, whether it has happened before, what the job pays, what staying costs, whose voice holds the veto, where she has already gone in her head — and only then what has to happen before it can be decided.

positions.name: What changed, the work or you
positions.job: What has actually changed here — the work itself, or what she is able to carry. Not which she would name

positions.name: Whether you've been here before
positions.job: The last time she left something like this, and what she told herself then. Whether this is the same exit or a different one

positions.name: What the job pays that isn't money
positions.job: What the job hands her besides the money. The thing she would have to replace the week after she left

positions.name: What another year in the chair costs
positions.job: What another year in the same chair costs her, and it is not money. Who she has become at home since it started

positions.name: Whose decision this really is
positions.job: Whose voice is in this decision. A mortgage, a partner, a parent's rule about steady work — and which one holds the veto

positions.name: Where you've already gone
positions.job: The point she had already left without moving. The tell in how she talks about the place now

positions.name: What has to happen before it can be decided
positions.job: What has to be found out or said first, before this is a decision and not a mood. What that costs her

the-reading-that-never-came-true.name: The Reading That Never Came True
the-reading-that-never-came-true.question: I was told it would have happened by now and it hasn't. Was any of it real?
the-reading-that-never-came-true.shape: A prediction has a week it landed in, a true half, a dated half, a bill and a comfort — name those five and the sixth is what still stands.

positions.name: What you were actually told
positions.job: What she was handed that day, and what she has carried since. The reading as it was given, not as it has grown

positions.name: What you went looking for that week
positions.job: What was happening in her life the week she went looking, and what she needed the answer to do

positions.name: The part that described something real
positions.job: Which part of what she was told described something real, and which part was only a month on a calendar

positions.name: What holding the date took from you
positions.job: What a year of holding a date took from her. The things she did not start because something was coming

positions.name: What keeping it alive still gives you
positions.job: What keeping the old prediction alive still gives her. While it stands, the thing is still coming and nothing has to be decided

positions.name: What still stands, and what's yours to do
positions.job: What still stands in her situation today, and the one move that is hers now the date has passed
